item.creategeoresonance.noise_cancellati: Filters ambient seismic noise from _caves_, _water_, and _lava_.
item.creategeoresonance.seismic_hammer.t: A handheld seismic striker that consumes _pressure_ to detect underground _caves_, _water_, and _lava_. Can also strike _mobs_.
Use Shift+Right-click to place. Then you can charge it using _rotation_, similar to backtank. Also can pull air from a worn _Backtank_.
When pressure is low, scans are _weaker_: depth is reduced and echo identity becomes ambiguous. Striking _dirt_, _sand_, or _gravel_ dampens scan depth.
item.creategeoresonance.seismogram.toolt: A printed _seismic chart_ showing detected signals and their estimated center heights.
Use in hand or offhand to read nearby signal distance and _approximate height_. Insert two into a _Seismic Projector_ for triangulation.
For valid projection, records must come from stations at least _8 blocks_ apart.
item.creategeoresonance.seismic_projecto: Combines _two seismograms_ to triangulate and project underground anomaly positions.
After loading the _first seismogram_, a red boundary and station position appear. Load the second that was scanned outside that boundary.
Needs at least _32 RPM_ and consumes a constant _512 SU_.
With an _empty hand_, retrieve the _last inserted seismogram_. Works without rotation. Breaking the projector returns loaded sheets.
Automates seismic strikes and prints a _seismogram_ after each scan cycle.
Needs at least _32 RPM_ and a constant _256 SU_.
Each installed module adds _64 SU_. Last modules signals are prioritized.

creategeoresonance.ponder.tag.seismic.de: Locate caves, fluids and ore signatures without digging blind
creategeoresonance.ponder.seismic_hammer: Survey terrain with the Seismic Hammer
Seismic Hammer reveals underground anomalies using surface impacts.
Strike the surface to send a seismic pulse.
Gray return marks cave. Deeper objects echoes take longer to return.
creategeoresonance.ponder.seismic_statio: Power and run a Seismic Station
Place the Seismic Station on the surveyed terrain.
Power the rear shaft input of station.
Load paper and ink sac on the table side.
Right-click the station to start scanning. Each strike returns one echo.
When scanning finishes, collect the Seismogram from the table side.
Modules define what the Seismic Station reports.
Noise Cancellation removes cave, water, and lava signals.
Target modules work at any height within the scan range.
Target modules add specific signatures, like redstone.
Diamond module marks diamond targets, including deepslate variants.
Shift + Right-click the station upper-right block to extract the last module.
Up to 8 module slots are available. Last modules signals are prioritized.
